Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the Greek title Oedipus Tyrannus corresponds to “Oedipus at Colonus,” rather than the well-established equivalent “Oedipus Rex” (Oedipus the King). This misinterpretation of the title mapping would lead to an incorrect fill for the blank and diverted the process into unnecessary verification loops despite sources already indicating Oedipus Rex.
